csv_project_name: DB for COTP 525-kV Series Capacitors Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Power Marketing Agency of the U.S. Department of Energy, intends to solicit proposals for the project described herein. In accordance with FAR Subpart 36.101-2 and FAR Part 15, the solicitation will be for a Fixed-Price, TwoPhase Design-Build contract for end-of-lifecycle replacement of four (4) banks of 525-kV series capacitors installed at four (4) substation locations within the California Oregon Transmission Project (COTP), which consists of the Tracy-Olinda and Olinda-Captain Jack 525-kV transmission lines. Performance will begin at time of award, with completion no later than June 30, 2033. The Contractor will engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) by removing and replacing the existing series capacitor banks with new and in-kind series capacitor banks (no changes to series capacitor size, rating, segmentation, and line compensation level). The Contractor shall perform engineering design for full integration of new series capacitor banks into WAPA s existing substation; as well as procure, install, test and commission all equipment.
